# Matthew Ramsden

Matthew Ramsden's public homepage collects his work, apps, projects, writing, videos, Nostr profile, X profile, and PGP key.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.matthewramsden.com/): Public links for work, apps, projects, writing, and videos.
- [Expanded agent overview](https://www.matthewramsden.com/llms-full.txt): Full plain-text summary of site content for LLM ingestion.
- [PGP key](https://www.matthewramsden.com/pgp.txt): Public PGP key.

## Writing

- [Introducing BDK Swift Example Wallet](https://www.matthewramsden.com/posts/2024/10-14.html): Design decisions for an iOS example wallet built with Bitcoin Dev Kit 1.0 and bdk-ffi Swift bindings.
